verdict.rationale: Zep's governance docs describe RBAC for dashboard users and ABAC policies on API keys and UserGroups that limit which actions and context agents and Memory MCP users can reach. They also state that Context Graph operations are subject to authorization and audit controls, with Audit Logs for dashboard activity and API Logs for API requests. missing for 10: explicit documentation of read-versus-write permission granularity in policies, audit coverage beyond 'supported' API requests, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can govern who and what can read or write memory with roles, policies, or access-control lists, and audit that access

citations.quote: Role-based access control governs dashboard users. Attribute-based access control governs API keys and UserGroups.
Limit which actions and context each agent and Memory MCP user can reach with ABAC policies attached to API keys and UserGroups.
Zep applies authorization and audit controls to Context Graph operations.
Audit Logs record dashboard activity, and API Logs record supported API request activity.
